title: zanthoxylum humile
intro: Zanthoxylum humile, commonly known as Mexican prickly ash, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum humile include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
